extracted.name: Twilight Flatbread
extracted.description: A quick way to make flatbread.
ingredient_lines: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil for coating
instruction_lines: Mix all the ingredients for flatbread, except 1/4 cup of oil. Form a ball.
Coat with oil and let rest covered for 1 hour.
After an hour deflate the dough.
Separate into 6 equal parts and roll out the dough. And fry the bread till done on each side. As you turn them add butter mixture to the topside, along to a bit of salt to taste.
Brush the bread as it gets done with the garlic butter. When done serve I hope you enjoy!!!
